model.title: Dolores River National Conservation Area and Special Management Area Act
model.meta: Energy and Natural Resources Committee · Sen. Michael Bennet (D-CO)

summary.text: The bill would establish a National Conservation Area and Special Management Area along the Dolores River in Colorado to protect its natural, recreational, scenic, cultural, and historical values. It would require management plans for both areas, permit Native American tribes to use the land for traditional ceremonies and gathering, protect the Ponderosa Gorge section by restricting roads and motorized access, and remove certain river segments from consideration for federal Wild and Scenic Rivers designation.
